$comment: Vercel does NOT interpolate ${ENV} into cron paths, and cron requests cannot set arbitrary custom headers. Vercel automatically attaches `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET` to cron invocations when CRON_SECRET is set in project env. The api/db-seed.js endpoint must validate that header server-side (coupling: another agent updates db-seed.js to read CRON_SECRET from the Authorization header instead of the old ?token= query param). Do NOT put secrets in the cron path.
